pages.text_en:
History
Longido District is one of the districts in Arusha Region , northern Tanzania, officially established in 2007 after being split from Monduli District. The district borders Kenya to the northeast through the Namanga international border , which serves as a major gateway for trade and transportation between Tanzania and Kenya. Longido District is in northern Tanzania, near Mount Longido , an area famous for its natural beauty and historical importance to the Maasai community .
The district covers an area of approximately 7,885 square kilometers . The climate is semi-arid with low rainfall, making pastoralism—the main economic activity—predominantly practiced by the Maasai community. This pastoralism involves cattle, goats, and sheep, significantly contributing to the income and livelihoods of Longido residents. However, in recent years, efforts have been made to promote irrigated farming and horticulture, particularly in water-rich areas like Ketumbeine and Engarenaibor .
Longido District has a total of 20 wards , namely: Longido, Engikaret, Kimokouwa, Olmolog, Orbomba, Tingatinga, Gelai Lumbwa, Gelai Meirugoi, Ketumbeine, Elang’ata Dapash, Engarenaibor, Magadini, Kamwanga, Matale, Mundarara, Oltepesi, Sinoni, Ngereyani, Namanga, and Ilorienito. Each ward contains villages governed locally , collaborating with the district government to manage development. The district’s border with Kenya at Namanga makes Longido a key area for cross-border trade, tourism, and small-scale social and economic diplomacy .
Longido District has a health infrastructure that includes a district hospital , which provides essential services to residents. The hospital is equipped with modern facilities and staffed with skilled professionals in various medical fields. In addition, the district has several health centers and dispensaries providing primary health care services in rural areas. The district government, in collaboration with development partners, continues to improve health services and increase access to medicines and mother-and-child-friendly services .
Regarding education, Longido District has numerous primary and secondary schools , built through collaboration between the government, parents, and development partners. The number of schools has increased due to the growing demand for education among children from pastoralist communities, who previously lacked access because of their nomadic lifestyle. The government has put in place robust strategies to ensure education reaches all children, including free primary education and improving learning environments, particularly for girls.
Besides social and economic activities, Longido District is fortunate to have unique tourist attractions . These include Mount Longido , Enduimet Wildlife Reserve (part of the elephant migration route from Amboseli in Kenya to Tarangire National Park), scenic natural landscapes, and Maasai cultural heritage , which attracts visitors from around the world. Tourists are attracted to the Maasai's traditional lifestyle, clothing, dances, and customary leadership practices. Traditional leaders, such as Laigwanan and elders, play a crucial role in the community and in preserving customary land and lifestyle management.
Overall, the history of Longido District is built on the foundations of Maasai culture , social and economic development efforts, and unique geographical features that provide residents with opportunities in pastoralism, cross-border trade, tourism, and education . The Longido District Government , in collaboration with residents and development partners, continues to build a strong foundation for sustainable and democratic development , ensuring improved quality of life for the people of Longido.

Historia
Wilaya ya Longido ni mojawapo ya wilaya za Mkoa wa Arusha, kaskazini mwa Tanzania, iliyoanzishwa rasmi mwaka 2007 baada ya kugawanywa kutoka Wilaya ya Monduli. Wilaya hii inapakana na Kenya upande wa kaskazini mashariki kupitia mpaka wa kimataifa wa Namanga, ambayo ni lango kuu la biashara na usafirishaji baina ya Tanzania na Kenya. Wilaya ya Longido ipo katika eneo la kaskazini mwa Tanzania na inapatikana kando ya Mlima wa Longido, miongoni mwa maeneo maarufu ya asili na kihistoria kwa jamii ya Kimasai.
Eneo la Wilaya ya Longido lina ukubwa wa takribani kilomita za mraba 7,885. Hali ya hewa ni ya ukame na wastani wa mvua ni mdogo, hali inayofanya shughuli kuu ya kiuchumi kuwa ni ufugaji wa asili, unaofanywa na jamii ya Wamasai. Ufugaji huu unahusisha ng’ombe, mbuzi, na kondoo, na unachangia pakubwa kipato na maisha ya wananchi wa Longido. Hata hivyo, kwa miaka ya hivi karibuni, jitihada zimekuwa zikifanyika kuhamasisha kilimo cha umwagiliaji na bustani hasa katika maeneo yenye maji kama vile Ketumbeine na Engarenaibor.
Wilaya ya Longido ina jumla ya kata 20 ambazo ni: Longido, Engikaret, Kimokouwa, Olmolog, Orbomba, Tingatinga, Gelai Lumbwa, Gelai Meirugoi, Ketumbeine, Elang’ata Dapash, Engarenaibor, Magadini, Kamwanga, Matale, Mundarara
, Oltepesi, Sinoni, Ngereyani, Namanga, na Ilorienito. Katika kila kata kuna vijiji vyenye uongozi wa serikali ya kijiji, ambavyo vinashirikiana na serikali ya wilaya kusimamia maendeleo ya wananchi. Mpaka wake na Kenya kupitia Namanga huifanya Longido kuwa sehemu muhimu kwa biashara za mpakani, utalii, na shughuli za kidiplomasia ndogo ndogo za kijamii na kiuchumi.
Wilaya ya Longido ina miundombinu ya afya inayojumuisha hospitali ya wilaya ambayo ipo na inatoa huduma zote muhimu kwa wananchi. Hospitali hii ina vifaa vya kisasa na wahudumu waliobobea katika fani mbalimbali za tiba. Mbali na hospitali hiyo, wilaya ina jumla ya vituo kadhaa vya afya na zahanati zinazotoa huduma za msingi kwa jamii katika maeneo ya vijijini. Serikali ya wilaya kwa kushirikiana na wadau wa maendeleo imekuwa ikiboresha huduma za afya na kuongeza upatikanaji wa dawa na huduma rafiki kwa akina mama na watoto.
Kwa upande wa elimu, Wilaya ya Longido ina shule nyingi za msingi na sekondari, zilizojengwa kwa ushirikiano kati ya serikali, wazazi, na wadau wa maendeleo. Shule hizi zimeendelea kuongezeka kutokana na uhitaji wa elimu kwa watoto wa jamii ya kifugaji, ambao awali walikosa fursa ya kupata elimu kutokana na mtindo wa maisha wa kuhamahama. Serikali imeweka mikakati madhubuti ya kuhakikisha elimu inawafikia watoto wote, ikiwemo elimu ya msingi bila malipo na uboreshaji wa mazingira ya kujifunzia hasa kwa wasichana.
Mbali na shughuli za kijamii na kiuchumi, Wilaya ya Longido imebahatika kuwa na vivutio vya kipekee vya kitalii. Miongoni mwa vivutio hivyo ni pamoja na Mlima Longido, hifadhi ya wanyamapori ya Enduimet ambayo ni sehemu ya usafiri wa tembo kutoka Amboseli (Kenya) hadi hifadhi ya Tarangire, mandhari nzuri ya asili, na utamaduni wa Kimasai ambao huvutia wageni kutoka sehemu mbalimbali duniani. Watalii huvutiwa na maisha ya jadi ya jamii ya Kimasai, mavazi yao ya asili, ngoma za asili, na mfumo wao wa uongozi wa kimila. Viongozi wa kimila kama Laigwanan na wazee wa mila wana nafasi kubwa katika jamii na katika kutunza utaratibu wa maisha na ardhi ya kijadi.
Kwa ujumla, historia ya Wilaya ya Longido imejengwa juu ya misingi ya utamaduni wa Kimasai, jitihada za maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi, na mazingira ya kipekee ya kijiografia yanayowapa wakazi wake fursa ya kushiriki katika shughuli mbalimbali ikiwemo ufugaji, biashara ya mpakani, utalii na elimu. Serikali ya Wilaya ya Longido kwa kushirikiana na wananchi na wadau wa maendeleo inaendelea kujenga msingi imara wa maendeleo endelevu na ya kidemokrasia ili kuhakikisha maisha bora kwa wakazi wa Longido.

Dhima na Dira
Dira ya Halmashauri
"Kuwa halmashauri inayoongoza na jumuishi katika utoaji endelevu wa huduma bora za kijamii na kiuchumi zinazoinua maisha ya jamii ya Longido."
Dhima ya Halmashauri
"Kutatua rasilimali kwa ufanisi, uwazi, na uwajibikaji katika kutoa huduma jumuishi, za ubunifu, na bora za kijamii na kiuchumi, huku tukikuza ushiriki wa jamii na uhifadhi wa mazingira kwa ustawi wa wananchi wa Longido."

Strategic Plan (2025/2026 – 2029/2030 )
Longido District Council
Introduction
This Five-Year Strategic Plan (2025/2026 – 2029/2030) has been developed to guide Longido District Council in realizing its Vision and Mission through sustainable provision of quality social and economic services to the people. The plan is designed to accelerate economic growth, promote good governance, and foster inclusive and sustainable development.
Strategic Focus Areas
The strategic plan emphasizes:
Enhancing productivity in agriculture and livestock through strengthened extension services and modern techniques.
Expanding rural infrastructure , including feeder roads, water schemes, and school/health facilities.
Strengthening community-based financial systems , particularly SACCOS and small business cooperatives.
Empowering women and youth through income-generating programs and entrepreneurship training.
Addressing climate change through mitigation and adaptation measures in agriculture, water and natural resource management.
Improving financial management and accountability by strengthening systems, transparency, and internal audit controls.
Investing in human capital through continuous capacity building, recruitment, and professional development of council staff.
Delivering quality social services , including education, health, water, and sanitation.
Promoting good governance as the foundation for peace, justice, security and sustainable socio-economic development.
Cross-Cutting Issues
The plan integrates key cross-cutting issues that affect sustainable development:
Environmental Conservation – Mainstreaming climate and environmental sustainability across all sectors.
Gender Equality – Promoting equal participation and access to resources and opportunities for all genders.
HIV/AIDS Response – Strengthening public education, prevention, and community support programs in collaboration with TACAIDS, CSOs, and health partners.
Youth & Vulnerable Groups – Creating inclusive platforms and programs for economic and social empowerment.
I nstitutional Support and Partnerships
Longido District Council acknowledges the continued support received through:
Local Government Capital Development Grant (LGCDG)
Health Basket Funding System (HBFS)
National and International Development Partners
Community-Based and Civil Society Organizations
Implementation Framework
This plan is structured to include:
Vision & Mission Statements
Strategic Objectives and Targets aligned with national frameworks (e.g., Vision 2025, SDGs, MKUKUTA, etc.)
Sectoral Strategies and Priorities
Performance Indicators to monitor progress
Baseline Data where available, to support planning and reporting
Monitoring & Evaluation
A robust Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) framework will be used to track progress against key performance indicators. This will enable timely adjustments, resource alignment, and evidence-based decision-making.
Acknowledgment
Longido District Council expresses its sincere appreciation to all stakeholders who participated in the formulation of this Strategic Plan. Special thanks go to:
Honorable Councillors
Ward and Village Executive Officers
Divisional Secretaries
Political and Religious Leaders
Civil Society Organizations
Development Partners
Their dedication and insights have been vital in shaping a shared vision for Longido's development.

Mpango Mkakati (2025/2026 – 2029/2030)
Utangulizi
Mpango huu wa Miaka Mitano ya Mkakati (2025/2026 – 2029/2030) umeandaliwa kuongoza Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido katika kutimiza Dira na Dhima yake kupitia utoaji endelevu wa huduma bora za kijamii na kiuchumi kwa wananchi. Mpango huu umebuniwa ili kuharakisha ukuaji wa uchumi, kuendeleza utawala bora, na kuhimiza maendeleo jumuishi na endelevu .
Eneo la Mkakati
Mpango huu unalenga kwenye maeneo muhimu yafuatayo:
Kuongeza tija katika kilimo na ufugaji kupitia huduma za ugani zilizoimarishwa na mbinu za kisasa.
Kupanua miundombinu ya vijijini , ikiwemo barabara za vijijini, miradi ya maji, na shule/hospitali.
Kuimarisha mifumo ya kifedha ya kijamii , hasa SACCOS na ushirika wa biashara ndogo ndogo.
Kuwezesha wanawake na vijana kupitia programu za kuongeza kipato na mafunzo ya ujasiriamali.
Kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi kupitia hatua za kupunguza madhara na kuendana nayo katika kilimo, maji, na usimamizi wa rasilimali asilia.
Kuboresha usimamizi wa fedha na uwajibikaji kwa kuimarisha mifumo, uwazi, na ukaguzi wa ndani.
Kuwekeza katika rasilimali watu kupitia uboreshaji endelevu wa uwezo, uajiri, na maendeleo ya kitaaluma ya wafanyakazi wa halmashauri.
Kutoa huduma bora za kijamii , ikiwemo elimu, afya, maji, na usafi wa mazingira.
Kukuza utawala bora kama msingi wa amani, haki, usalama, na maendeleo endelevu ya kijamii na kiuchumi.
Masuala Yanayochangia Mipaka Yote (Cross-Cutting Issues)
Mpango huu unajumuisha masuala muhimu yanayohusiana na maendeleo endelevu :
Uhifadhi wa Mazingira – Kuingiza uthabiti wa tabianchi na mazingira katika sekta zote.
Usawa wa Jinsia – Kukuza ushiriki sawa na upatikanaji wa rasilimali na fursa kwa wote.
Ushughulikiaji wa VVU/HIV – Kuimarisha elimu ya umma, kuzuia maambukizi, na programu za jamii kwa kushirikiana na TACAIDS, CSOs, na wadau wa afya.
Vijana na Makundi Yaliyo Hatari – Kuunda jukwaa na programu jumuishi za uwezeshaji wa kiuchumi na kijamii.
Msaada wa Taasisi na Ushirikiano
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido inatambua msaada endelevu unaopatikana kupitia:
Mfuko wa Maendeleo ya Mitaji wa Serikali za Mitaa (LGCDG)
Mfumo wa Mfuko wa Afya (HBFS)
Wadau wa Maendeleo wa Kitaifa na Kimataifa
Mashirika ya Kijamii na Asasi za Kiraia
Mfumo wa Utekelezaji
Mpango huu umeundwa kujumuisha:
Dira na Dhima
Malengo na Vilele vya Mkakati vinavyolingana na mfumo wa kitaifa (mfano: Vision 2025, SDGs, MKUKUTA, n.k.)
Mikakati na Vipaumbele vya Sekta
Viashiria vya Utendaji kwa ajili ya kufuatilia maendeleo
Takwimu za Awali pale zinapopatikana ili kusaidia upangaji na ripoti
Ufuatiliaji na Tathmini (Monitoring & Evaluation)
Mfumo imara wa Ufuatiliaji na Tathmini (M&E) utatumika kufuatilia maendeleo dhidi ya viashiria muhimu vya utendaji . Hii itawawezesha kufanya marekebisho kwa wakati, kupanga rasilimali ipasavyo, na kufanya maamuzi kwa msingi wa ushahidi.
Shukrani
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido inatoa shukrani zake za dhati kwa wadau wote walioshiriki katika utengenezaji wa Mpango Mkakati huu . Shukrani maalum zinatolewa kwa:
Madiwani Waheshimiwa
Maafisa Utendaji wa Kata na Vijiji
Katibu wa Wilaya
Viongozi wa Kisiasa na Kiroho
Mashirika ya Kiraia
Wadau wa Maendeleo
Dhana zao, jitihada, na maarifa yamekuwa muhimu katika kuunda dira ya pamoja ya maendeleo ya Longido .

FINANCE AND ACCOUNTING UNIT
INTRODUCTION
The Finance Department is one of the key departments in the Council, responsible for managing revenue collection and the utilization of funds. This department also provides professional advice on the optimal use of financial resources in accordance with government laws, regulations, and procedures.
The Finance Department is divided into three main sections:
Expenditure Section
Revenue Section
Final Accounts Section
1. EXPENDITURE SECTION
Responsibilities of this section include:
Preparing all Council payments.
Preparing the ordinary expenditure budget.
Ensuring that all necessary documents for payments are available before and after payments are made.
Ensuring full compliance with financial procedures and laws.
Maintaining records of all payments made.
Reconciling bank statements with the Council’s books.
Preparing financial reports and submitting them to the relevant authorities on time.
2. REVENUE SECTION
Responsibilities of this section include:
Managing the collection of all Council revenues in accordance with laws and guidelines.
Establishing a reliable system for revenue control.
Timely depositing of cash and bank cheques.
Preparing and submitting various revenue reports.
Ensuring a simple and secure system for cash payments to clients.
Designing new sources of revenue to increase the Council’s income.
3. FINAL ACCOUNTS SECTION
Responsibilities of this section include:
Reconciling statements between the Council’s cashbook and bank statements.
Responding to audit queries.
Preparing reports on the Council’s revenues and expenditures.
Maintaining financial books (cashbooks).
Preparing the Council’s year-end financial statements in accordance with government guidelines.
OBJECTIVES OF THE FINANCE DEPARTMENT FOR THE 2025/2026 FINANCIAL YEAR
In the 2025/2026 financial year, the Finance Department of the Council aims to achieve the following objectives:
Increase domestic revenue collection by at least 20% through effective management and improvement of collection systems.
Design and develop new revenue sources, particularly from the business, land, and social services sectors.
Ensure budget preparations reflect the priorities of the Council’s development plan, in line with the budget guidelines issued by the central government.
Timely submission of all financial reports (quarterly reports, final accounts, etc.) to the National Audit Office (NAOT) , TAMISEMI , and other stakeholders.
Strengthen financial management by ensuring all payments comply with financial procedures and laws.
Respond promptly and thoroughly to all audit queries from internal and external auditors.
Provide training to finance department staff on the use of electronic systems such as MUSE and TAUSI .
Ensure monthly reconciliation of financial statements between bank and cashbooks, maintaining accurate records.
Increase the use of ICT in financial operations, including promoting electronic payment of services.
Improve the working environment for department staff, including the availability of office equipment and essential documents.

KITENGO FEDHA NA UHASIBU
﻿UTANGULIZI
Idara ya Fedha ni miongoni mwa idara muhimu katika Halmashauri, inayoshughulika na usimamizi wa ukusanyaji wa mapato na matumizi ya fedha. Idara hii pia hutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu matumizi bora ya rasilimali za kifedha kwa mujibu wa sheria, kanuni na taratibu za Serikali.
Idara ya Fedha imegawanyika katika sehemu tatu kuu, ambazo ni:
Sehemu ya Matumizi
Sehemu ya Mapato
Sehemu ya Taarifa za Mwisho za Hesabu za Halmashauri (Final Account)
1. SEHEMU YA MATUMIZI
Majukumu ya sehemu hii ni:
Kuandaa malipo yote ya Halmashauri.
Kuandaa bajeti ya matumizi ya kawaida.
Kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa nyaraka zote muhimu za malipo kabla na baada ya malipo kufanyika.
Kuhakikisha taratibu na sheria za fedha zinafuatwa kikamilifu.
Kuhifadhi majalada ya kumbukumbu ya malipo yote yaliyofanyika.
Kufanya usuluhisho wa kimahesabu kati ya taarifa za benki na vitabu vya Halmashauri.
Kuandaa taarifa za kifedha na kuziwasilisha katika mamlaka husika kwa wakati.
2. SEHEMU YA MAPATO
Majukumu ya sehemu hii ni:
Kusimamia ukusanyaji wa mapato yote ya Halmashauri kwa mujibu wa sheria na miongozo.
Kuweka mfumo thabiti wa udhibiti wa mapato.
Kuweka fedha taslimu na hundi benki kwa wakati.
Kuandaa na kuwasilisha ripoti mbalimbali za mapato.
Kuweka utaratibu rahisi na salama wa malipo ya fedha taslimu kwa wateja.
Kubuni vyanzo vipya vya mapato kwa ajili ya kuongeza mapato ya Halmashauri.
3. SEHEMU YA TAARIFA ZA KIMAHESABU (FINAL ACCOUNT)
Majukumu ya sehemu hii ni:
Kuandaa usuluhisho wa taarifa kati ya cashbook ya Halmashauri na taarifa za benki.
Kujibu hoja za ukaguzi wa hesabu.
Kuandaa taarifa za mapato na matumizi ya Halmashauri.
Kutunza vitabu vya fedha (cashbook).
Kuandaa vitabu vya mwisho wa mwaka wa fedha vya Halmashauri kwa mujibu wa miongozo ya Serikali.
MALENGO YA IDARA YA FEDHA KWA MWAKA WA FEDHA 2025/2026
Katika mwaka wa fedha 2025/2026, Idara ya Fedha ya Halmashauri inalenga kutekeleza malengo yafuatayo:
Kuongeza ukusanyaji wa mapato ya ndani kwa asilimia angalau 20 kupitia usimamizi madhubuti na uboreshaji wa mifumo ya ukusanyaji.
Kubuni na kuendeleza vyanzo vipya vya mapato , hasa kutoka katika sekta za biashara, ardhi, na huduma za kijamii.
Kuhakikisha maandalizi ya bajeti yanazingatia vipaumbele vya mpango wa maendeleo wa halmashauri , kwa kuzingatia mwongozo wa bajeti uliotolewa na serikali kuu.
Kuwasilisha kwa wakati taarifa zote za kifedha (quarterly reports, final accounts, n.k.) kwa Ofisi ya Taifa ya Ukaguzi (NAOT), TAMISEMI, na wadau wengine.

Kutoa elimu na mafunzo kwa watumishi wa idara ya fedha kuhusu matumizi ya mifumo ya kielektroniki kama vile MUSE,TAUSI
Kuhakikisha usuluhisho wa taarifa za fedha kati ya benki na vitabu vya fedha unafanyika kila mwezi , na kuweka kumbukumbu sahihi.
Kuongeza matumizi ya TEHAMA katika shughuli za fedha , ikiwa ni pamoja na kuhamasisha ulipaji wa huduma kwa njia ya kielektroniki.
Kuboresha mazingira ya kazi ya watumishi wa idara , ikiwa ni pamoja na upatikanaji wa vifaa vya ofisi na nyaraka muhimu.

PRE-PRIMARY AND PRIMARY EDUCATION DIVISION
The objective of the Pre-Primary and Primary Education Division is to plan and oversee the implementation of laws, policies, guidelines and directives related to the provision of pre-primary education, primary education, special needs education, as well as non-formal education.
To achieve this objective, the division performs several functions including planning the availability, distribution and utilization of resources in primary schools; supervising continuous assessment and national examinations in primary schools; and overseeing the provision of adult education and non-formal education at the pre-primary and primary levels.
In addition, the division coordinates the provision of life skills education in primary schools, conducts assessments of the needs for special education, adult education and non-formal education, and provides advice on the establishment and development of adult education and non-formal education centers.
Other responsibilities of the division include supervising the implementation of primary education plans and programs, developing and maintaining databases for pre-primary and primary education, and coordinating and supervising sports activities in primary schools.
The division is headed by the Head of Division and is organized into four sections, namely:
Academic Section
Equipment and Statistics Section
Special Needs Education Section
Adult Education and Non-Formal Education Section
Academic Section
The Academic Section is responsible for coordinating the implementation of policies, plans, guidelines and directives related to pre-primary and primary education at the school level. It also coordinates and supervises continuous assessment and national examinations including the Standard Two National Assessment (STNA) , Standard Four National Assessment (SFNA) and the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) .
The section also monitors and evaluates the implementation of pre-primary and primary education plans, prepares reports on the implementation of education development programs, and coordinates the provision of education for self-reliance while supervising income-generating projects in primary schools.
Equipment and Statistics Section
The Equipment and Statistics Section is responsible for collecting, analyzing and interpreting data related to pre-primary and primary education. It also coordinates the availability, distribution and utilization of educational resources in primary schools.
Other responsibilities include preparing enrollment statistics and school resource information, producing reports on the implementation of education development programs, and identifying resource needs for schools within the Council.
Special Needs Education Section
This section is responsible for preparing and supervising the implementation of special education programs at the pre-primary and primary education levels. It identifies children with special needs and facilitates their placement in appropriate schools.
The section also collects data on students with special needs, provides relevant advice, and coordinates the availability, distribution and utilization of resources required for special education.
Adult Education and Non-Formal Education Section
This section is responsible for preparing and supervising the implementation of adult education and non-formal education programs at the pre-primary and primary education levels. It also coordinates life skills education and conducts needs assessments related to adult education and non-formal education.
Furthermore, the section provides advice on the establishment and development of adult education and non-formal education training centers and coordinates the availability, distribution and utilization of resources for these programs.
Status of Schools and Students
The Pre-Primary and Primary Education Division supervises a total of 75 primary schools in Longido District. Among these, 59 are government schools while 16 are privately owned schools .
All schools together have a total of 38,734 students , of whom 20,687 are boys and 18,047 are girls .
At the pre-primary level, government schools have 5,449 pupils , while private schools have 902 pupils . At the primary level, government schools have 30,277 pupils , while private schools have 2,106 pupils .
Student Enrollment
In 2024 , a total of 9,181 children were expected to enroll in pre-primary education, out of which 7,920 pupils were enrolled, representing 86 percent of the target.
In 2025 , the projected enrollment was 6,191 pupils , and 6,097 pupils were enrolled, representing 98 percent of the target.
For Standard One , in 2024 the projected enrollment was 6,117 pupils , and 5,404 pupils were enrolled, representing 88.5 percent of the target.
In 2025 , the projected enrollment was 7,867 pupils , and 6,853 pupils were enrolled, representing 86 percent of the target.
Status of Infrastructure in Government Primary Schools
Government primary schools require a total of 755 classrooms , of which 516 are available , leaving a shortage of 239 classrooms , equivalent to 32 percent .
The required number of toilet pits is 1,399 , while 756 are available , resulting in a shortage of 643 , equivalent to 46 percent .
Regarding desks , the total requirement is 15,461 , while 7,105 are available , resulting in a shortage of 8,356 desks , equivalent to 54 percent .
In addition, the required number of teachers’ houses is 456 , while 202 are available , leaving a shortage of 254 houses , equivalent to 56 percent .
Academic Performance
In the Primary School Leaving Examination (PSLE) , in 2022 , a total of 2,387 pupils sat for the examination and 1,676 pupils passed , representing 70.21 percent .
In 2023 , 2,887 pupils sat for the examination and 2,140 pupils passed , representing 74.13 percent .
In 2024 , 2,957 pupils sat for the examination and 2,227 pupils passed , representing 75.31 percent .
For the Standard Four National Assessment (SFNA) , in 2022 , 3,531 pupils sat for the assessment and 3,079 pupils passed , representing 87.20 percent .
In 2023 , 4,082 pupils sat for the assessment and 3,437 pupils passed , representing 84.20 percent .
In 2024 , 4,705 pupils sat for the assessment and 3,862 pupils passed , representing 82.08 percent .

IDARA YA ELIMU YA AWALI NA MSINGI
Lengo la Idara ya Elimu ya Awali na Msingi ni kupanga na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sheria, sera, nyaraka na miongozo inayohusu utoaji wa elimu ya awali, elimu ya msingi, elimu ya mahitaji maalumu pamoja na elimu nje ya mfumo rasmi.
Ili kufikia lengo hilo, idara inatekeleza majukumu mbalimbali ambayo ni pamoja na kupanga upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali katika shule za msingi, kusimamia upimaji endelevu na mitihani ya taifa kwa shule za msingi, pamoja na kusimamia utoaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika ngazi ya awali na msingi.
Aidha, idara inaratibu utoaji wa elimu ya stadi za maisha katika shule za msingi, kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu maalumu, elimu ya watu wazima na elimu nje ya mfumo rasmi. Pia hutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji na uendelezaji wa vituo vya elimu ya watu wazima na elimu nje ya mfumo rasmi.
Majukumu mengine ya idara ni kusimamia utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za elimu ya msingi, kuunda na kutunza kanzidata ya elimu ya awali na msingi, pamoja na kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za michezo katika shule za msingi.
Idara hii inaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara na imegawanyika katika sehemu nne ambazo ni:
Sehemu ya Taaluma
Sehemu ya Vifaa na Takwimu
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Mahitaji Maalumu
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi
Sehemu ya Taaluma
Sehemu ya Taaluma ina jukumu la kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, mipango, nyaraka na miongozo ya elimu ya awali na msingi katika ngazi ya shule. Pia inasimamia na kuratibu upimaji endelevu pamoja na mitihani ya kitaifa ya darasa la pili (STNA), darasa la nne (SFNA) na darasa la saba (PSLE).
Sehemu hii pia inafuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mipango ya elimu ya awali na msingi, kuandaa taarifa za utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za maendeleo ya elimu, pamoja na kuratibu utoaji wa elimu ya kujitegemea na kusimamia miradi ya kujiingizia kipato katika shule za msingi.
Sehemu ya Vifaa na Takwimu
Sehemu ya Vifaa na Takwimu inahusika na ukusanyaji, uchambuzi na tafsiri ya takwimu za elimu ya awali na msingi. Aidha, inaratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali za elimu katika shule za msingi.
Majukumu mengine ni kuandaa takwimu za uandikishaji wa wanafunzi pamoja na vifaa vya shule, kuandaa taarifa za utekelezaji wa maendeleo ya elimu, na kubainisha mahitaji ya rasilimali za shule katika Halmashauri.
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Mahitaji Maalumu
Sehemu hii ina jukumu la kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa elimu maalumu katika ngazi ya elimu ya awali na msingi. Pia hutambua watoto wenye mahitaji maalumu na kuwasaidia kupata nafasi za masomo katika shule zinazofaa.
Aidha, sehemu hii hukusanya taarifa za wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalumu na kutoa ushauri unaofaa, pamoja na kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali zinazohitajika kwa ajili ya elimu maalumu.
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi
Sehemu hii ina jukumu la kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu nje ya mfumo rasmi katika ngazi ya awali na msingi. Pia huratibu elimu ya stadi za maisha, kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya elimu ya watu wazima na elimu nje ya mfumo rasmi, na kutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji na uendelezaji wa vituo vya mafunzo ya aina hii ya elimu.
Sehemu hii pia huratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali zinazohitajika kwa ajili ya elimu ya watu wazima na elimu nje ya mfumo rasmi.
Hali ya Shule na Wanafunzi
Idara ya Elimu ya Awali na Msingi inasimamia jumla ya shule za msingi 75 katika Wilaya ya Longido. Kati ya hizo, shule 59 ni za serikali na shule 16 ni za watu binafsi .
Shule zote zina jumla ya wanafunzi 38,734 , ambapo wavulana ni 20,687 na wasichana ni 18,047 .
Kwa upande wa wanafunzi katika ngazi ya elimu ya awali, shule za serikali zina wanafunzi 5,449 , wakati shule binafsi zina wanafunzi 902 . Katika elimu ya msingi, shule za serikali zina wanafunzi 30,277 , huku shule binafsi zikiwa na wanafunzi 2,106 .
Uandikishaji wa Wanafunzi
Katika mwaka 2024, jumla ya watoto 9,181 walikadiriwa kuandikishwa katika elimu ya awali, ambapo wanafunzi 7,920 waliandikishwa sawa na asilimia 86 ya lengo.
Mwaka 2025, makadirio yalikuwa wanafunzi 6,191 , na jumla ya wanafunzi 6,097 waliandikishwa sawa na asilimia 98 ya lengo.
Kwa upande wa darasa la kwanza, mwaka 2024 makadirio yalikuwa wanafunzi 6,117 , ambapo wanafunzi 5,404 waliandikishwa sawa na asilimia 88.5 ya lengo.
Mwaka 2025, makadirio yalikuwa wanafunzi 7,867 , ambapo wanafunzi 6,853 waliandikishwa sawa na asilimia 86 ya lengo.
Hali ya Miundombinu katika Shule za Serikali
Kwa sasa shule za msingi za serikali zinahitaji jumla ya vyumba vya madarasa 755 , ambapo vilivyopo ni 516 , hivyo kuna upungufu wa 239 sawa na asilimia 32 .
Mahitaji ya matundu ya vyoo ni 1,399 , ambapo yaliyopo ni 756 , hivyo kuna upungufu wa 643 sawa na asilimia 46 .
Kwa upande wa madawati , mahitaji ni 15,461 , yaliyopo ni 7,105 , hivyo kuna upungufu wa 8,356 sawa na asilimia 54 .
Aidha, mahitaji ya nyumba za walimu ni 456 , ambapo zilizopo ni 202 , hivyo kuna upungufu wa 254 sawa na asilimia 56 .
Maendeleo ya Kitaaluma
Katika mtihani wa kumaliza elimu ya msingi (PSLE), mwaka 2022 wanafunzi 2,387 walifanya mtihani na kati yao 1,676 walifaulu sawa na asilimia 70.21 .
Mwaka 2023 wanafunzi 2,887 walifanya mtihani na wanafunzi 2,140 walifaulu sawa na asilimia 74.13 .
Mwaka 2024 wanafunzi 2,957 walifanya mtihani na wanafunzi 2,227 walifaulu sawa na asilimia 75.31 .
Kwa upande wa mtihani wa darasa la nne (SFNA), mwaka 2022 wanafunzi 3,531 walifanya mtihani na wanafunzi 3,079 walifaulu sawa na asilimia 87.20 .
Mwaka 2023 wanafunzi 4,082 walifanya mtihani na wanafunzi 3,437 walifaulu sawa na asilimia 84.20 .
Mwaka 2024 wanafunzi 4,705 walifanya mtihani na wanafunzi 3,862 walifaulu sawa na asilimia 82.08 .

SECONDARY EDUCATION DIVISION
The development of secondary education in Longido District is still at an early stage due to the historical background of the area and its relatively low economic status. The district is mainly inhabited by pastoralist communities who spend a significant portion of their time moving with livestock in search of pasture and water. Other contributing factors include the remoteness of the area, the presence of wildlife conservation areas, and limited economic infrastructure.
As a result, up to the year 2005 , the district had only one public secondary school , located in Longido Ward . The number of public secondary schools increased to five in 2006 and reached fifteen by 2025 . These schools are located in the wards of Longido, Namanga, Engarenaibor, Tingatinga, Gilai Lumbwa, Olmolog, Sinya, Mundarara, Gilai Merugoi, Orbomba, Noondoto, Kimokouwa, Kamwanga, Matale, and Ketumbeine . In addition, there is one private secondary school located in Engikaret Ward .
By the end of 2025 , the number of public secondary schools increased significantly following the government campaign aimed at ensuring that each ward has at least one secondary school . Out of the 18 wards in the district , 15 wards successfully constructed secondary schools .
Secondary School Student Enrollment
The number of students enrolled in secondary schools in Longido District has increased due to the expansion of school infrastructure and growing awareness among parents about the importance of education. Between 2009 and 2011 , enrollment increased by an average of 26 percent per year , and between 2022 and 2025 , the growth rate rose to 32 percent .
Female students slightly outnumbered male students, although the gap has been gradually decreasing. Efforts are ongoing to achieve a 1:1 gender parity by 2026 .
By 2024 , the district had established two Advanced Level secondary schools , enrolling a total of 842 students , including 322 boys and 520 girls . The number of students at the Advanced Level increased to 1,072 students (including 322 boys and 750 girls ) by 2025 .
Therefore, district authorities are advised to ensure that the remaining wards complete the construction of secondary school infrastructure and continue building more Advanced Level schools to accommodate all students who complete Ordinary Level (Form Four) .
Status and Availability of School Facilities
The quantity and quality of facilities in secondary schools in Longido District are considered moderate. However, there is still a need for more classrooms, toilets, teachers’ houses, libraries, laboratories, hostels, and desks/chairs .
Teachers
By the end of 2024 , Longido District had 280 teachers distributed across 15 public secondary schools , giving a ratio of one teacher for every 18 students .
Only five wards — Longido, Olmolog, Tingatinga, Engarenaibor, and Namanga —had at least 20 teachers per school .
Teachers’ Houses
The district faces a shortage of teachers’ houses in almost all wards. Local authorities are advised to prioritize the construction of teachers’ houses as an incentive for teachers and as a strategy to improve teaching efficiency.
Classrooms
The district experienced a 25 percent shortage of classrooms , with shortages ranging between 14 percent and 60 percent across different wards.
Hostels
Hostels are essential due to the district’s geographical conditions and the scattered nature of settlements. By 2024 , there was a 60 percent shortage of hostels , with Namanga, Olmolog, and Tingatinga wards being the most affected.
Adequate hostel facilities would help reduce long walking distances for students, school dropouts, teenage pregnancies, and absenteeism.
Libraries
Libraries are important for improving students’ knowledge and learning skills. By the end of 2024 , a library was available only in Longido Ward . This situation indicates that students in other wards lack access to additional reading materials.
Local authorities are therefore advised to incorporate library construction into future school development plans.
Desks and Chairs
There is a shortage of desks and chairs in all secondary schools. By the end of 2024 , the district had a shortage of 1,634 desks and chairs , equivalent to 23 percent .
The wards most affected by this shortage include Orbomba, Tingatinga, and Matale , while other wards experience relatively smaller shortages.
Laboratories
Laboratories are essential for students studying science subjects. The district had 45 laboratories distributed across all 15 secondary schools .
Technical and Vocational Training
Longido District has one vocational training institution providing technical education and skills training.
Adult Education
The district has not made significant progress in reducing illiteracy since 2007 . As primary and secondary education continue to expand, adult education programs should also be expanded , using primary schools as learning centers.
The district is therefore advised to conduct adult education campaigns through school heads under the MEMKWA program .

DIVISHENI YA ELIMU YA SEKONDARI
Maendeleo ya elimu ya sekondari katika Wilaya ya Longido yako katika hatua za mwanzo kutokana na historia ya eneo hili na hali duni ya uchumi. Wilaya hii inakaliwa zaidi na jamii za wafugaji ambao hutumia sehemu kubwa ya muda wao kusafiri na mifugo kutafuta malisho na maji. Sababu nyingine ni umbali wa eneo hili, uwepo wa maeneo ya hifadhi za wanyamapori pamoja na upungufu wa miundombinu ya kiuchumi.
Kutokana na hali hiyo, hadi mwaka 2005 wilaya ilikuwa na shule moja tu ya sekondari ya umma , iliyokuwa katika Kata ya Longido . Idadi ya shule za sekondari za umma iliongezeka na kufikia tano mwaka 2006 na baadaye kuongezeka hadi kumi na tano mwaka 2025 . Shule hizi zipo katika kata za Longido, Namanga, Engarenaibor, Tingatinga, Gilai Lumbwa, Olmolog, Sinya, Mundarara, Gilai Meirugoi, Orbomba, Noondoto, Kimokouwa, Kamwanga, Matale na Ketumbeine . Aidha, kuna shule moja ya sekondari binafsi iliyopo Kata ya Engikaret .
Hadi kufikia mwisho wa mwaka 2025 , shule za sekondari za umma zimeongezeka kwa kasi kufuatia kampeni ya serikali ya kuhakikisha kuwa kila kata inakuwa na angalau shule moja ya sekondari . Kati ya kata 18 zilizopo wilayani, kata 15 zimefanikiwa kujenga shule za sekondari .
Usajili wa Wanafunzi wa Sekondari
Idadi ya wanafunzi wanaojiandikisha katika shule za sekondari wilayani Longido imekuwa ikiongezeka kutokana na kuimarika kwa miundombinu ya shule pamoja na kuongezeka kwa uelewa wa wazazi kuhusu umuhimu wa elimu. Kati ya mwaka 2009 na 2011 , usajili wa wanafunzi uliongezeka kwa wastani wa asilimia 26 kwa mwaka , na kati ya 2022 na 2025 kiwango cha ukuaji kiliongezeka hadi asilimia 32 .
Kwa ujumla, idadi ya wanafunzi wa kike imekuwa juu kidogo kuliko wavulana , ingawa tofauti hiyo imekuwa ikipungua hatua kwa hatua. Jitihada zinaendelea kuhakikisha kuwa uwiano wa jinsia wa 1:1 unafikiwa ifikapo mwaka 2026 .
Hadi mwaka 2024 , wilaya iliweza kuanzisha shule mbili za sekondari za kidato cha tano na sita , ambapo jumla ya wanafunzi 842 walidahiliwa, wakiwemo wavulana 322 na wasichana 520 . Idadi ya wanafunzi katika ngazi ya Elimu ya Juu ya Sekondari (Advanced Level) iliongezeka na kufikia wanafunzi 1,072 mwaka 2025 , wakiwemo wavulana 322 na wasichana 750 .
Hivyo basi, mamlaka za wilaya zinashauriwa kuhakikisha kuwa kata zilizobaki zinakamilisha miundombinu ya shule za sekondari na kuendelea kujenga shule zaidi za kidato cha tano na sita ili kuwapatia nafasi wanafunzi wote wanaomaliza kidato cha nne .
Hali ya Vifaa vya Shule
Kiasi na ubora wa vifaa katika shule za sekondari wilayani Longido uko katika kiwango cha wastani. Hata hivyo, bado kuna uhitaji mkubwa wa madarasa, vyoo, nyumba za walimu, maktaba, maabara, hosteli pamoja na meza na viti .
Walimu
Hadi mwisho wa mwaka 2024 , Wilaya ya Longido ilikuwa na jumla ya walimu 280 waliogawanywa katika shule 15 za sekondari za umma , hali inayotoa uwiano wa mwalimu mmoja kwa wanafunzi 18 .
Ni kata tano tu ambazo zilikuwa na walimu wasiopungua 20 kwa kila shule , ambazo ni Longido, Olmolog, Tingatinga, Engarenaibor na Namanga .
Nyumba za Walimu
Wilaya inakabiliwa na uhaba wa nyumba za walimu katika karibu kata zote . Hivyo, mamlaka za mitaa zinashauriwa kutoa kipaumbele katika ujenzi wa nyumba za walimu ili kuwahamasisha walimu kufanya kazi kwa ufanisi zaidi.
Madarasa
Wilaya inakabiliwa na upungufu wa madarasa kwa asilimia 25 , ambapo katika baadhi ya kata upungufu huo unakadiriwa kuwa kati ya asilimia 14 hadi 60 .
Hosteli
Hosteli ni muhimu kutokana na hali ya kijiografia ya wilaya na mtawanyiko wa makazi ya wananchi . Hadi mwaka 2024 , kulikuwa na upungufu wa hosteli kwa asilimia 60 , huku kata za Namanga, Olmolog na Tingatinga zikiwa zimeathirika zaidi.
Upatikanaji wa hosteli za kutosha unaweza kusaidia kupunguza changamoto za wanafunzi kutembea umbali mrefu kwenda shule, utoro, kuacha shule pamoja na mimba za utotoni .
Maktaba
Maktaba ni muhimu katika kuongeza maarifa na ujuzi wa wanafunzi . Hadi mwisho wa mwaka 2024 , maktaba ilikuwepo katika Kata ya Longido pekee , hali inayomaanisha kuwa wanafunzi katika kata nyingine hawapati vitabu vya ziada vya kujisomea.
Kutokana na hali hiyo, mamlaka za mitaa zinashauriwa kujumuisha ujenzi wa maktaba katika mipango ya maendeleo ya shule kwa siku zijazo.
Meza na Viti
Kuna uhaba wa meza na viti katika shule zote za sekondari . Hadi mwisho wa mwaka 2024 , kulikuwa na upungufu wa meza na viti 1,634 , sawa na asilimia 23 ya mahitaji.
Kata zilizoathirika zaidi na upungufu huu ni Orbomba, Tingatinga na Matale , wakati kata nyingine zina upungufu mdogo.
Maabara
Maabara ni muhimu kwa wanafunzi wanaosoma masomo ya sayansi . Wilaya ilikuwa na jumla ya maabara 45 zilizopo katika shule zote 15 za sekondari .
Elimu ya Ufundi na Mafunzo ya Ujuzi
Wilaya ya Longido ina chuo kimoja cha mafunzo ya ufundi stadi kinachotoa elimu ya ufundi na mafunzo ya stadi mbalimbali kwa vijana.
Elimu ya Watu Wazima
Wilaya haijafanya maendeleo makubwa katika kupunguza tatizo la kutojua kusoma na kuandika tangu mwaka 2007 . Kadiri shule za msingi na sekondari zinavyoendelea kuongezeka, ni muhimu pia kupanua programu za elimu ya watu wazima kwa kutumia shule za msingi kama vituo vya kujifunzia.
Hivyo, wilaya inashauriwa kuendesha kampeni za elimu ya watu wazima kupitia wakuu wa shule chini ya mpango wa MEMKWA .

INFRASTRUCTURE RURAL AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT DIVISION
This is one of the departments in Longido District Council . The department has three (3) sections , which are:
Buildings
Roads
Machinery and Electricity
The functions carried out by each section are as follows:
1. BUILDINGS
a. Supervising the construction of various buildings for institutions and private individuals
For government buildings, we supervise the construction of secondary schools, primary schools, ward offices, hospitals, health centers, and various other government sector buildings .
b. Issuing building permits to institutions and private individuals
Permits are issued to those whose plots have been surveyed and to those whose plots have not yet been surveyed.
c. Providing technical advice on construction matters
We provide professional advice and review plans from individuals who want to build modern and quality houses.
d. Drawing plans and cost estimation
We provide services for drawing maps, preparing construction cost estimates, and preparing structural engineering drawings .
2. ROADS
We supervise the implementation of road works through various maintenance activities carried out every year. These include:
Routine maintenance
Maintenance of rough sections
Special/periodic maintenance
Opening new roads in neighborhoods and in newly surveyed plots
3. MACHINERY AND ELECTRICITY
This section performs the following tasks:
Supervising road construction works using district machinery
Coordinating machinery rental for private individuals
Supervising the connection of electricity in new government buildings
Carrying out maintenance of electricity in government buildings that are already connected

COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIVISION
INTRODUCTION
The Social Development Division is one of the divisions in Longido District Council and serves as a vital link between the Council and the community by coordinating and supervising development activities. The division has a total of 15 staff members , with 10 males and 5 females providing services at both the district and ward levels. At the district headquarters, there are 7 staff (3 males and 4 females), and at the ward level, there are 8 staff (7 males and 1 female).
OBJECTIVES OF THE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT DIVISION
To build sustainable community capacity by enabling communities to identify their needs, design, plan, implement, and manage development programs that improve their livelihoods, utilizing available resources to generate income and enhance their quality of life.
STRUCTURE OF THE DIVISION
The division is led by a Divisional Manager , assisted by two deputies:
Head of Cross-Cutting Issues Section
Head of Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) Section
Under these two sections, the division has five desks , which are:
Economic Empowerment and Poverty Reduction Desk
HIV/AIDS Coordination Desk
Gender and Child Development Desk
Community Participation Desk
NGO Coordination, Monitoring, and Registration Desk
The general responsibilities of the division and its desks are as follows:
GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT DIVISION
Engage communities in identifying opportunities and challenges for development.
Educate communities to eliminate beliefs, customs, and traditions that hinder development.
Facilitate community integration and empower special groups to access development opportunities to improve their welfare.
Coordinate the implementation of gender mainstreaming in programs and development plans across sectors.
Enable communities to utilize sectoral policies and strategies for their development.
Facilitate citizens to benefit from economic opportunities .
Promote the protection of child rights and upbringing .
Facilitate the registration, coordination, and monitoring of NGOs.
Help communities identify, reconcile, and prevent conflicts affecting development.
Coordinate and promote community participation in cross-cutting issues .
Provide education on community rights and responsibilities and coordinate the registration of legal aid service providers at the district level.
Educate communities on the benefits of national development projects for community welfare and national growth.
RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE DESKS
1. ECONOMIC EMPOWERMENT AND POVERTY REDUCTION DESK
Collaborate with the Council’s Empowerment Committee to implement economic empowerment strategies.
Encourage citizens to join SACCOs and VICOBA for savings and access to capital.
Analyze opportunities in large-scale investment projects and national initiatives and educate locals to participate or gain employment.
Coordinate the disbursement of loans derived from 10% of local revenue to empower women, youth, and people with disabilities.
Ensure the Council allocates areas for economic investment, such as agriculture, industries, and small to medium enterprises.
Monitor the implementation of economic investment activities and prepare reports on progress.
2. HIV/AIDS COORDINATION DESK
Provide training for people living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV) through VICOBA.
Ensure annual assessments of HIV/AIDS status are conducted and strategies are developed.
Promote the formation of support groups.
Compile and report HIV/AIDS activities to the HIV/AIDS Committee .
Collect coordination reports from wards and streets to provide advice on improving efficiency.
Monitor, evaluate, and coordinate planned HIV/AIDS activities.
Identify and evaluate activities of stakeholders implementing HIV/AIDS interventions.
Ensure all HIV/AIDS plans and stakeholder activities are incorporated into district and regional strategic plans to avoid duplication.
Ensure national HIV/AIDS policies, strategies, laws, guidelines, and research findings are accessible to stakeholders and communities.
Provide advice on policies or regulations regarding HIV/AIDS control.
Maintain a list of active stakeholders addressing HIV/AIDS issues.
3. GENDER AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT DESK
Coordinate programs on child rights and development implemented by stakeholders to ensure compliance with government policies, laws, and regional/international agreements.
Educate families, communities, and stakeholders on investing in child upbringing and early development for a better society built on unity and solidarity.
Integrate efforts of multiple child-focused stakeholders to avoid conflicts and misuse of resources.
Ensure child abuse is addressed through national programs and stakeholder collaboration.
Raise community awareness on child rights, protection, and welfare using radio, TV, celebrations, meetings, and dialogues.
Coordinate the collection, maintenance, analysis, and dissemination of child-related data.
Facilitate the establishment and operation of child councils at village, ward, and district levels.
Coordinate the establishment and operation of parenting groups at community levels.
Establish and monitor child rights violation registers at village, ward, and district levels.
Conduct gender analysis to identify and address gender issues within the district.
Ensure gender considerations are included in village, ward, and district plans.
Provide gender-related training as needed.
Offer referrals for victims of gender-based violence to social welfare, police, legal advisors, and hospitals .
4. COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION DESK
Engage communities to identify opportunities and barriers to development

DIVISHENI YA MAENDELEO YA JAMII
UTANGULIZI:
Divisheni ya Maendeleo ya Jamii ni miongoni mwa divisheni zilizopo katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido, na ni kiungo muhimu kati ya Halmshauri na Jamii kwa kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za kimaendeleo. Divisheni ya maendeleo ya jamii ina Jumla ya watumishi 15 ambapo wanaume 10 na wanawake 5 wanaotoa huduma kwa ngazi ya Wilaya na kata. Ambapo makao makuu ya willaya kuna watumishi 7 (me 3 ke 4) ngazi ya kata watumishi 8 (me 7 ke 1).
MALENGO LA DIVESHENI YA MAENDELEO YA JAMII
Kujenga uwezo wa jamii endelevu, kwa kuwezesha jamii katika kubaini mahitaji yao, kubuni, kuandaa, kutekeleza na kusimamia mipango ya kujiletea maendeleo kwa kutumia kikamilifu rasilimali zilizopo kwa kujipatia na kujiongezea kipato kwa kuimarisha hali ya maisha ya jamii.
MUUNDO WA DIVISHENI
Divisheni ya maendeleo ya jamii inaongozwa na mkuu wa divisheni chini ya wasaidizi wawili ambao ni Mkuu wa sehemu ya masuala ya mtambuka na Mkuu wa sehemu ya mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali. Chini ya sehemu mbili za Divisheni kuna Madawati tano ambayo ni:- Dawati la uwezeshaji wananchi kiuchumi na kupunguza umaskini,Dawati la uratibu wa kupambana na maambukizi ya ukimwi, Dawati la maendeleo ya jinsia na mtoto, dawati la ushirikishwaji wa jamii na dawati la uratibu, ufuatiliaji na usajili wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali NGOS. Majukumu ya jumla ya Divisheni na madawati husika yameainishwa kama ifuatavyo:
MAJUKUMU YA JUMLA YA DIVISHENI YA MAENDELEO YA JAMII .
Kushirikisha Jamii katika kuainisha fursa na changamoto zinazoikabili ili kulijiletea Maendeleo.
Kuelimisha Jamii kuondokana na Fikra, Imani, Mila, Desturi na Tamaduni Zinazokinzana na Maendeleo.
Kushirikisha Jamii katika Kuwaunganisha na Kuwawezesha makundi Maalum katika fursa na Mchakato wa Maendeleo ili kuinua ustawi wao.
Kuratibu Utekelezaji na Uzingatiaji wa Masuala ya Jinsia Katika Programu na Mipango ya Maendeleo Katika Sekta Mbalimbali.
Kuwezesha Jamii Kutumia Fursa ya Sera za Kisekta na Mikakati yake katika Kujiletea Maendeleo.
Kuwezesha Wananchi Kunufaika na Fursa za Kiuchumi.
Kuwezesha Jamii Kutekeleza Haki na Malezi ya Mtoto.
Kuwezesha Usajili, Kuratibu na Ufuatiliaji wa Mashirika Yasiyo ya Kiserikali
uwezesha Jamii Kutambua, Kuanisha na Kuzuia Migogoro inayoathiri Maendeleo katika Jamii
Kuratibu na Kuhamasisha Ushiriki wa Jamii katika Masuala Mtambuka.
Kutoa Elimu ya Haki na Wajibu wa Jamii na Kuwezesha Uratibu na Usajili wa Watoa Huduma za Msaada wa Kisheria Katika Ngazi Wilaya
Kuelimisha Jamii Faida za miradi mikubwa ya kitaifa Kwa maendeleo ya Taifa na fursa Kwa jamii
MAJUKUMU YA MADAWATI
DAWATI LA UWEZESHAJI WANANCHI KIUCHUMI NA KUPUNGUZA UMASKINI
Kushirikiana na Kamati ya Uwezeshaji ya Hamashauri kutekeleza Mkakati wa Uwezeshaji wananchi kiuchumi;
Kuhamasisha wananchi kujiunga na SACCOS na VICOBA kwa lengo la kujiwekea akiba na kupata mitaji;
Kuchambua fursa zilizoko katika Miradi mikubwa ya uwekezaji na miradi ya Kitaifa na kuelimisha wazawa ili waweze kushiriki/kuajiriwa;
Kuratibu utoaji wa mikopo inayotokana na asilimia 10% ya mapato ya ndani ya Halmashauri kwa ajili ya kuwezesha wanawake, vijana na watu wenye ulemavu;
Kuhakikisha Halmashauri inatenga maeneo maalum ya uwekezaji kiuchumi kama vile kilimo, viwanda na biashara ndogondogo na za kati; na
Kufuatilia utekelezaji wa shughuli za uwekezaji kiuchumi katika Halmashauri na kuandaa taarifa ya utekelezaji.
DAWATI LA URATIBU WA KUPAMBANA NA MAAMBUKIZI YA UKIMWI,
Mafunzo ya VICOBA kwa watu wanaoishi na virus vya UKIMWI(WAVIU)
Kuhakikisha tathmini ya hali halisi ya VVU na UKIMWI katika Halmashauri inafanyika na kuweka mikakati ya Kila mwaka.
Kuhamasisha kuunda
Kutoa taarifa za shughuli za VVU na UKIMWI kwenye kikao cha kamati ya UKIMWI
Kupitiaa taarifa za uratibu zinazofanywa na Kata na Mitaa ili kutoa ushauri wa namna ya kuimarisha na kuongeza ufanisi.
Kuratibu, kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa shughuli za VVU na UKIMWI zilizopangwa.
Kutambua na kutathmini shughuli za wadau mbalimbali wanaotekeleza afua za VVU, na UKIMWI katika Halmashauri. Vikundi vya WAVIUna wajane.
Kuhakikisha mipango yote ya UKIMWI na wadau wanaotekeleza katika Halmashauri inaingizwa kwenye Mpango Mkakati wa UKIMWI wa Halmashauri na Mkoa ili kuondoa urudufu wa juhudi na rasilimali.
Kuhakikisha sera, Mkakati wa Taifa wa kudhibiti UKIMWI, sheria, Miongozo na matokeo ya tafiti mbalimbali ya masuala ya UKIMWI yanawafikia wadau na wananchi kwa ujumla.
Kutoa ushauri kwa ngazi inayohusika kuhusu Sera au sheria ndogo juu ya udhibiti wa VVU na UKIMWI.
Kuhakikisha uwepo wa orodha ya wadau hai wa Masuala ya UKIMWI.
DAWATI LA MAENDELEO YA JINSIA NA MTOTO
Kuratibu program za haki na Maendeleo ya Mtoto zinazotekelezwa na wadau ili kuhakikisha zinafuata Sera, Sheria za Serikali na Mikataba ya Kikanda na Kimataifa iliyolenga Haki za Mtoto.
Kuhamasisha na Kuelimisha familia, jamii na wadau katika kuwekeza kwenye malezi, makuzi na maendeleo ya awali ya mtoto ili kuwa na jamii bora iliyojengwa kwa misingi ya umoja na mshikamano wa kitaifa.
Kuunganisha nguvu za wadau mbali mbali wanaofanya kazi za watoto ili kuepusha migongano na matumizi mabaya ya rasilimali fedha na watu.
Kuhakikisha ukatili dhidi ya watoto unatokomezwa kupitia mipango na program za kitaifa ambazo zimeandaliwa kwa kushirikiana na wadau.
Kuongeza uelewa wa jamii kuhusu masuala ya haki, ulinzi na ustawi wa mtoto kupitia uelimishaji umma kwa kutumia vipindi vya redio za jamii, runinga, maadhimisho, mikutano na midahalo.
Kuratibu ukusanyaji, uhuishwaji, uchambuzi na usambazaji wa takwimu zinazohusu watoto.
Kuratibu uanzishwaji na uendeshaji wa mabaraza ya watoto katika ngazi ya kijiji, Kata, na Wilaya.
Kuratibu uanzishwaji na uendeshwaji wa vikundi vya malezi kwa familia katika ngazi ya jamii.
Kuanzisha na kufuatilia matumizi ya rejista ya matukio ya uvunjifu wa haki za watoto na namna yalivyoshughulikiwa katika ngazi ya kijiji, Kata na Halmashauri.
Kuhakikisha kuwa masuala ya jinsia katika Halmashauri yanatambuliwa kwa kufanya uchambuzi wa jinsia (gender analysis).
Kuhakikisha masuala ya jinsia yanaingizwa katika mipango ya vijiji, Mitaa na Halmashauri.
Kuwezesha mafunzo mbali mbali ya jinsia kwa kadri ya mahitaji.
Kutoa rufaa kwa wahanga wa ukatili wa jinsia (Ustawi wa Jamii, Polisi, Wanasheria na Hospitali).
DAWATI LA USHIRIKISHWAJI WA JAMII

AGRICULTURE, LIVESTOCK AND FISHERIES DIVISION
﻿ INTRODUCTION
The Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries Division is among the important divisions in the Longido District Council. The division is responsible for coordinating, supervising and promoting the development of the agriculture, livestock and fisheries sectors in order to strengthen food security, increase the income of citizens, and contribute to the economic development of the District and the Nation as a whole.
The division provides extension services to farmers, livestock keepers and fishers in collaboration with various development partners in these sectors.
2. VISION OF THE DIVISION
To become a centre for sustainable development of agriculture, livestock and fisheries by utilizing modern knowledge, available resources and stakeholder collaboration in order to ensure food security, increase community income and protect the environment.
3. MISSION OF THE DIVISION
To provide quality, professional and productive services to farmers, livestock keepers and fishers in Longido District by promoting the effective use of available technologies and resources for sustainable development.
4. FUNCTIONS OF THE DIVISION
To provide professional advisory services to farmers, livestock keepers and fishers.
To coordinate crop, livestock and fish production activities.
To promote the use of improved agricultural and livestock technologies.
To supervise the establishment and management of demonstration farms and practical training centres.
To provide education on proper livestock nutrition and improved pasture management, including identifying grazing areas and facilitating the issuance of customary land use certificates in collaboration with development partners.
To coordinate livestock vaccination and treatment services.
To supervise and coordinate markets for crops, livestock and fish products.
To promote sustainable fishing and modern fish farming practices.
To coordinate the implementation of government policies and guidelines related to these sectors.
5. SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE DIVISION
a) Agriculture Sector
Provision of professional advice on improved farming practices and timely weather information.
Facilitation of access to agricultural inputs such as improved seeds, fertilizers and pesticides.
Training on organic farming and modern agricultural practices.
Provision of market information and crop price updates.
Education on irrigation farming and post-harvest management.
Soil health assessment in collaboration with research institutions, especially TARI, and providing guidance to farmers on suitable crops based on soil conditions.
b) Livestock Sector
Provision of livestock vaccination and treatment services.
Advisory services on improved livestock keeping and breeding using improved breeds such as Sahiwal and Boran.
Education on livestock nutrition and both natural and improved pasture management.
Issuance of permits and registration of livestock infrastructure such as dips and dams.
Construction and improvement of livestock infrastructure including cattle dips, dams, livestock markets and crushes.
Conducting regular meat inspection and slaughterhouse inspections to ensure safe meat for consumers.
c) Fisheries Sector
Training on sustainable fishing and fish farming practices.
Issuance of fishing licenses and legal permits.
Education on fish preservation and processing techniques.
Advisory services on the establishment of fish ponds.
d) Cooperative Sector
The cooperative sector is a socio-economic system that involves cooperative societies aimed at bringing together the efforts of members, particularly farmers, fishers, livestock keepers and entrepreneurs, to achieve collective development.
In Longido District Council, the cooperative sector performs the following functions:
Mobilization and establishment of cooperative societies.
Inspection and supervision of cooperative societies.
Provision of education and training to cooperative societies.
Collection and analysis of cooperative societies’ data.
Supervision of the implementation of cooperative policies and laws.
Resolving disputes within cooperative societies.
Linking cooperative societies with business partners and markets.
6. DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS UNDER THE DIVISION
Crop production projects focusing on strategic crops such as maize, beans, sunflower and potatoes.
Construction and rehabilitation of livestock dips in various wards including villages such as Eworendeke, Irkaswa, Engikaret and Olmog.
Fish farming projects through fish ponds in areas such as Namanga and Longido.
Establishment of demonstration farms for modern agriculture in areas such as Namanga and Longido.
Livestock vaccination programs across the district.
Establishment of youth and women groups involved in agriculture, livestock and fisheries.
Reducing conflicts between wildlife and farmers or livestock keepers by establishing a demonstration farm in Tingatinga village using beehives as a mitigation measure.
7. STRATEGIES FOR THE YEAR 2025/2026
Increasing production of food and cash crops.
Improving agricultural and livestock infrastructure.
Empowering citizens through production groups and SACCOS.
Expanding the use of modern technologies in agriculture and livestock production.
Strengthening collaboration with the private sector in crop and livestock markets.
Promoting fish farming as an economic opportunity for yo

DIVISHENI YA KILIMO, UFUGAJI NA UVUVI
﻿ UTANGULIZI
Divisheni ya Kilimo, Mifugo na Uvuvi ni miongoni mwa divisheni muhimu katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido. Divisheni hii ina jukumu la kuratibu, kusimamia na kuendeleza sekta za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi ili kuimarisha usalama wa chakula, kuongeza kipato cha wananchi na kuchangia maendeleo ya uchumi wa Wilaya na Taifa kwa ujumla.
Divisheni hii hutoa huduma za ugani kwa wakulima, wafugaji na wavuvi kwa kushirikiana na wadau mbalimbali wa maendeleo katika sekta hizo.
2. DIRA YA DIVISHENI
Kuwa kitovu cha maendeleo endelevu ya kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi kinachotumia maarifa ya kisasa, rasilimali zinazopatikana na ushirikiano wa wadau ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula, kuongeza kipato cha wananchi na kulinda mazingira.
3. DHIMA YA DIVISHENI
Kutoa huduma bora, za kitaalamu na zenye tija kwa wakulima, wafugaji na wavuvi wa Wilaya ya Longido kwa kuzingatia matumizi ya teknolojia na rasilimali zilizopo kwa ajili ya maendeleo endelevu.
4. MAJUKUMU YA DIVISHENI
Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kwa wakulima, wafugaji na wavuvi.
Kuratibu shughuli za uzalishaji wa mazao, mifugo na samaki.
Kuhamasisha matumizi ya teknolojia bora za kilimo na ufugaji.
Kusimamia uendeshaji wa mashamba darasa na vituo vya mafunzo kwa vitendo.
Kutoa elimu ya lishe bora ya mifugo na matumizi ya malisho bora pamoja na kuainisha maeneo ya malisho na kuyapatia hati miliki za kimila kwa kushirikiana na wadau wa maendeleo.
Kuratibu huduma za chanjo na matibabu ya mifugo.
Kusimamia na kuratibu masoko ya mazao, mifugo na samaki.
Kuhamasisha uvuvi endelevu na ufugaji wa samaki kwa njia za kisasa.
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera na miongozo ya Serikali katika sekta hizi.
5. HUDUMA ZINAZOTOLEWA NA DIVISHENI
a) Sekta ya Kilimo
Ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu mbinu bora za kilimo pamoja na upatikanaji wa taarifa za hali ya hewa kwa wakati.
Upatikanaji wa pembejeo za kilimo kama mbegu bora, mbolea na viuatilifu.
Mafunzo ya kilimo hai na kilimo cha kisasa.
Taarifa za masoko na bei za mazao.
Elimu ya kilimo cha umwagiliaji na uhifadhi wa mazao baada ya kuvuna.
Kufahamu afya ya udongo kwa kushirikiana na taasisi za utafiti hasa TARI, kutoa ushauri kwa wakulima na kusaidia kuchagua mazao sahihi kulingana na udongo.
b) Sekta ya Mifugo
Huduma za chanjo na matibabu ya mifugo.
Ushauri juu ya ufugaji bora na uboreshaji wa mifugo kwa kutumia madume bora kama Sahiwal na Boran.
Elimu kuhusu lishe ya mifugo na matumizi ya malisho ya asili pamoja na malisho ya kisasa.
Utoaji wa vibali na usajili wa majosho na malambo.
Ujenzi wa miundombinu ya mifugo kama majosho, malambo, minada na vibanio.
Kufanya ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa nyama na machinjio ili kuhakikisha usalama wa walaji.
c) Sekta ya Uvuvi
Mafunzo ya uvuvi endelevu na ufugaji wa samaki.
Kutoa leseni na vibali vya uvuvi halali.
Elimu kuhusu uhifadhi na usindikaji wa mazao ya uvuvi.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji wa mabwawa ya kufugia samaki.
d) Sekta ya Ushirika
Sekta ya ushirika ni mfumo wa kiuchumi na kijamii unaojumuisha vyama vya ushirika vinavyolenga kuunganisha nguvu za wanachama, hasa wakulima, wafugaji, wavuvi na wajasiriamali ili kufanikisha maendeleo ya pamoja.
Katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido, sekta ya ushirika ina majukumu yafuatayo:
Kuhamasisha na kuanzisha vyama vya ushirika.
Kufanya ukaguzi na usimamizi wa vyama vya ushirika.
Kutoa elimu na mafunzo kwa vyama vya ushirika.
Kuhifadhi na kuchambua takwimu za vyama vya ushirika.
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera na sheria za ushirika.
Kutatua migogoro ndani ya vyama vya ushirika.
Kuviunganisha vyama vya ushirika na wabia wa biashara.
6. MIRADI YA MAENDELEO INAYOSIMAMIWA
Mradi wa upandaji wa mazao ya kimkakati kama mahindi, maharage, alizeti na viazi.
Mradi wa ujenzi na ukarabati wa majosho ya mifugo katika kata mbalimbali kama vile vijiji vya Eworendeke, Irkaswa, Engikaret na Olmog.
Mradi wa ufugaji wa samaki kwenye mabwawa katika maeneo kama Namanga na Longido.
Mradi wa mashamba darasa ya kilimo bora cha kisasa katika maeneo ya Namanga na Longido.
Mradi wa utoaji wa chanjo za mifugo wilayani kote.
Mradi wa uanzishaji wa vikundi vya vijana na wanawake katika sekta za kilimo, mifugo na uvuvi.
Kupunguza migogoro kati ya wanyamapori na wakulima au wafugaji kwa kuanzisha shamba darasa la mfano katika kijiji cha Tingatinga kwa kutumia mizinga ya nyuki.
7. MIKAKATI YA MWAKA 2025/2026
Kuongeza uzalishaji wa mazao ya chakula na biashara.
Kuboresha miundombinu ya kilimo na mifugo.
Kuwezesha wananchi kupitia vikundi vya uzalishaji na SACCOS.
Kupanua matumizi ya teknolojia za kisasa katika kilimo na ufugaji.
Kukuza ushirikiano na sekta binafsi katika masoko ya mazao na mifugo.
Kuhamasisha ufugaji wa samaki kama fursa ya kiuchumi kwa vijana.

ADMINISTRATIONA AND HUMAN RESOURCES MANAGEMENT DIVISION
Longido District Council
The Division of Administration and Human Resource Management at Longido District Council plays a vital role in managing human resources, establishing good governance systems, and ensuring that public servants deliver quality services to citizens while adhering to work ethics, efficiency, and accountability.
Main Responsibilities of the Department of Administration and Human Resource Management
1. Human Resource Management
Preparing staffing requirements according to departmental needs.
Conducting recruitment processes for new employees in accordance with approvals from PO-RALG (TAMISEMI) and the Public Service Recruitment Secretariat .
Monitoring employees’ career development and maintaining their records.
2. Coordination of Staff Training
Preparing short-term and long-term training plans.
Monitoring employees who are undertaking studies.
Facilitating professional development and improving work efficiency.
3. Managing Workplace Discipline
Handling disciplinary matters of employees in accordance with the Public Service Regulations .
Providing guidance on workplace discipline, ethics, and integrity.
4. Facilitating Internal Communication
Managing daily operations within the Director’s Office.
Coordinating management meetings, Full Council meetings, and standing committee meetings.
5. Management of Security, Protection, and Protocol
Coordinating the activities of office security guards.
Organizing the reception of national leaders and other official visitors.
6. Office, Records, and Postal Management
Managing the system for receiving and distributing official correspondence.
Maintaining council records and documentation.
Supervising the reception of office supplies and ensuring building cleanliness.
7. Improving the Working Environment
Facilitating cleaning services, office maintenance, and creating a conducive working environment for effective performance.
Sections within the Department of Administration and Human Resource Management
This department is divided into four (4) main sections , each with specific responsibilities:
1. Public Service Section
Coordinates new recruitment, transfers, promotions, confirmations, and retirement benefits.
Manages the Human Resource Management Information System (HRMIS) database.
Coordinates employee performance appraisal through PEPMIS .
2. Training and Staff Development Section
Coordinates professional training programs.
Manages both long-term and short-term studies.
Issues training permits and coordinates the return of employees after completing their studies.
3. Office Administration Section
Manages office services such as cleaning, security, reception, and document distribution.
Coordinates the operations of the Director’s Office.
Ensures proper management of office records and equipment.
4. Security, Protocol, and Internal Communication Section
Coordinates reception of government leaders and official guests.
Manages council protocol procedures.
Oversees the security of government buildings.

DIVISHENI YA UTAWALA NA USIMAMIZI WA RASILIMALI WATU
Divisheni ya Utawala na Usimamizi wa Rasilimali Watu katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido ni kiungo muhimu katika kusimamia rasilimali watu, kuweka mifumo ya utawala bora, na kuhakikisha watumishi wa umma wanatoa huduma bora kwa wananchi kwa kuzingatia maadili ya kazi, ufanisi na uwajibikaji.
MAJUKUMU MAKUU YA DIVISHENI YA UTAWALA NA USIMAMIZI WA RASILIMALI WATU
1. Usimamizi wa Rasilimali Watu
Kuandaa mahitaji ya ajira kulingana na mahitaji ya divisheni na vitengo vya halmashauri.
Kuendesha mchakato wa ajira mpya kwa mujibu wa vibali vinavyotolewa na TAMISEMI na Sekretarieti ya Ajira katika Utumishi wa Umma.
Kufuatilia maendeleo ya watumishi kazini na kuhifadhi taarifa zao za kiutumishi.
2. Kuratibu Mafunzo kwa Watumishi
Kuandaa mipango ya mafunzo ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu kwa watumishi.
Kufuatilia watumishi waliopo masomoni.
Kuwezesha uboreshaji wa taaluma na kuongeza ufanisi kazini.
3. Kusimamia Nidhamu Kazini
Kushughulikia masuala ya kinidhamu ya watumishi kwa mujibu wa Kanuni za Utumishi wa Umma.
Kutoa miongozo ya nidhamu, maadili na uadilifu kazini.
4. Kurahisisha Mawasiliano ya Ndani
Kusimamia shughuli za kila siku katika ofisi ya Mkurugenzi.
Kuratibu vikao vya menejimenti, Baraza la Madiwani na vikao vya Kamati za Kudumu.
5. Usimamizi wa Usalama, Ulinzi na Itifaki
Kuratibu shughuli za walinzi wa ofisi.
Kuratibu mapokezi ya viongozi wa kitaifa na wageni mbalimbali.
6. Usimamizi wa Ofisi, Nyaraka na Posta
Kusimamia mfumo wa mapokezi na usambazaji wa barua.
Kuhifadhi kumbukumbu na nyaraka za halmashauri.
Kusimamia upokeaji wa vifaa na usafi wa majengo ya ofisi.
7. Kusimamia Uboreshaji wa Mazingira ya Kazi
Kuwezesha huduma za usafi, matengenezo ya ofisi na kuhakikisha mazingira rafiki ya kazi kwa ajili ya utendaji bora wa watumishi.
SEHEMU ZILIZOPO KWENYE DIVISHENI YA UTAWALA NA USIMAMIZI WA RASILIMALI WATU
Divisheni hii imegawanyika katika seksheni kuu nne (4), kila moja ikiwa na majukumu maalum:
1. Seksheni ya Utumishi wa Umma
Kuratibu ajira mpya, uhamisho, upandishaji vyeo, uthibitisho kazini na mafao ya kustaafu.
Kusimamia kanzidata ya taarifa za watumishi kupitia mfumo wa HRMIS .
Kuratibu tathmini ya utendaji kazi kupitia mfumo wa PEPMIS .
2. Seksheni ya Mafunzo na Maendeleo ya Watumishi
Kuratibu mipango ya mafunzo ya kitaaluma kwa watumishi.
Kusimamia mafunzo ya muda mfupi na muda mrefu.
Kutoa vibali vya mafunzo na kuratibu marejeo ya watumishi waliomaliza masomo.
3. Seksheni ya Utawala wa Ofisi
Kusimamia huduma za kiofisi kama usafi, ulinzi, mapokezi na usambazaji wa nyaraka.
Kuratibu shughuli za uendeshaji wa Ofisi ya Mkurugenzi.
Kuhakikisha utunzaji sahihi wa nyaraka na vifaa vya ofisi.
4. Seksheni ya Usalama, Itifaki na Mawasiliano ya Ndani
Kuratibu mapokezi ya viongozi na wageni rasmi.
Kusimamia itifaki za halmashauri katika shughuli mbalimbali.
Kusimamia ulinzi wa majengo ya serikali na mali za halmashauri.

Industry, Trade and Investments Division
MAIN OBJECTIVE
To coordinate and create a conducive environment for the development of industries, trade, markets, and investment within Longido District Council.
RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE DEPARTMENT
The Department of Industry, Trade and Investment performs the following responsibilities:
Coordinate the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to industry, trade, markets, and investment.
Promote industrial development, trade, markets, and investment within the Council.
Plan and develop industrial zones and reserves in collaboration with key stakeholders.
Identify and promote opportunities for industrial development, trade, markets, and investment.
Promote the development of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) .
Develop investment proposals and projects.
Promote private sector development initiatives.
Establish and maintain a database for industries, businesses, markets, and investments.
Manage the One Stop Business Centre .
Conduct research aimed at promoting investment.
Coordinate the District Business Council/Forum .
Supervise auction and market activities within the Council.
Implement business development strategies for small traders and service providers.
Create a conducive business and investment environment for economic growth.
DEPARTMENTAL STRUCTURE
The Department of Industry, Trade and Investment is headed by the Head of Department and consists of two main sections:
Industrial Development and Investment Section
Trade and Markets Section
1. INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AND INVESTMENT SECTION
This section is responsible for the following activities:
Coordinating the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to the industrial and investment sectors.
Promoting and coordinating partnerships between the public and private sectors.
Allocating, developing, and monitoring industrial zones and reserves.
Providing advice on improvement of industrial policies and coordinating sectoral meetings.
Promoting the production of raw materials for industrial use.
Preparing and maintaining registers of industries and investments.
Planning and estimating levies for small industries.
Developing and updating investment profiles.
Promoting investment from the private sector.
Coordinating and advising investors.
Creating an enabling environment for investors.
This section is headed by an Officer in Charge .
2. TRADE AND MARKETS SECTION
This section performs the following responsibilities:
Overseeing the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to trade and markets.
Providing entrepreneurship training to the business community.
Coordinating and providing advice on business registration.
Analyzing trade and market data and providing appropriate recommendations.
Coordinating meetings of the District Business Council .
Promoting partnerships between the private sector and the public sector.
Supervising auction and market activities within the Council.
Collecting and disseminating information on markets for goods and services.
Implementing strategies to promote businesses for small traders and service providers.
Creating a conducive business environment within the district.
This section is also headed by an Officer in Charge .

Divisheni ya Viwanda, Biashara na Uwekezaji
DIVISHENI YA VIWANDA, BIASHARA NA UWEKEZAJI
LENGO KUU
Kuratibu na kuweka mazingira rafiki kwa maendeleo ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji ndani ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido.
MAJUKUMU YA DIVISHENI
Divisheni ya Viwanda, Biashara na Uwekezaji inatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu zinazohusiana na viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Kukuza maendeleo ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji katika Halmashauri.
Kupanga na kuendeleza maeneo ya viwanda na hifadhi kwa kushirikiana na wadau mbalimbali.
Kutambua na kuendeleza vivutio vya viwanda, biashara na uwekezaji.
Kukuza maendeleo ya Biashara Ndogo na za Kati (SMEs).
Kuandaa na kuendeleza mapendekezo pamoja na miradi ya uwekezaji.
Kuendeleza hatua za maendeleo ya sekta binafsi.
Kuanzisha na kusimamia kanzidata ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Kusimamia kituo kimoja cha huduma za biashara (One Stop Business Centre).
Kufanya tafiti za kukuza uwekezaji katika wilaya.
Kuratibu Jukwaa la Biashara la Wilaya.
Kusimamia shughuli za minada na masoko ndani ya Halmashauri.
Kutekeleza mkakati wa maendeleo ya biashara kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo na watoa huduma.
Kuweka mazingira bora ya biashara na uwekezaji kwa ajili ya kukuza uchumi wa wilaya.
MUUNDO WA DIVISHENI
Divisheni ya Viwanda, Biashara na Uwekezaji inaongozwa na Mkuu wa Divisheni na inajumuisha sehemu mbili kuu:
Sehemu ya Maendeleo ya Viwanda na Uwekezaji
Sehemu ya Biashara na Masoko
1. SEHEMU YA MAENDELEO YA VIWANDA NA UWEKEZAJI
Sehemu hii inahusika na shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu za sekta ya viwanda na uwekezaji.
Kukuza na kuratibu ubia kati ya sekta ya umma na sekta binafsi.
Kutenga, kuendeleza na kufuatilia maeneo ya viwanda na hifadhi.
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uboreshaji wa sera za viwanda na kuratibu mikutano ya kisekta.
Kukuza uzalishaji wa malighafi kwa matumizi ya viwandani.
Kuandaa na kutunza rejista za viwanda na vitega uchumi.
Kupanga na kukadiria ushuru kwa viwanda vidogo.
Kuendeleza na kupitia upya wasifu wa uwekezaji wa wilaya.
Kukuza uwekezaji kutoka sekta binafsi.
Kuratibu na kutoa ushauri kwa wawekezaji.
Kuweka mazingira wezeshi kwa wawekezaji.
Sehemu hii inaongozwa na Afisa Mfawidhi .
2. SEHEMU YA BIASHARA NA MASOKO
Sehemu hii inatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu za biashara na masoko.
Kutoa mafunzo ya ujasiriamali kwa jamii ya wafanyabiashara.
Kuratibu na kutoa ushauri kuhusu usajili wa biashara.
Kuchambua taarifa za biashara na masoko na kutoa ushauri stahiki.
Kuratibu kongamano la Baraza la Biashara la Wilaya.
Kukuza ubia kati ya sekta binafsi na sekta ya umma.
Kusimamia shughuli za minada na masoko ndani ya Halmashauri.
Kukusanya na kusambaza taarifa za masoko ya bidhaa na huduma.
Kutekeleza mkakati wa kukuza biashara kwa wachuuzi wadogo na watoa huduma.
Kuweka mazingira bora ya biashara ndani ya Wilaya.
