Division of Health, Nutrition and Social Walfare
1. Department Introduction
The Department of Health, Nutrition and Social Welfare is one of the key departments in the Longido District Council. The department is responsible for coordinating, supervising, and implementing health services, proper nutrition programs, and social welfare services for the residents of Longido District.
2. Vision and Mission of the Department
Vision
To have a community with good health, proper nutrition, and social well-being for sustainable development in Longido District.
Mission
To provide quality, inclusive, and sustainable health, nutrition, and social welfare services to the people of Longido while promoting equity, quality service delivery, human rights, and community participation.
3. Units Under the Department
A. Health Unit
This unit oversees the provision of primary health care services, preventive services, treatment services, and health education at the community level with the aim of improving health services for the Longido community while ensuring quality, equity, and accessibility for all.
Services provided include:
Maternal and Child Health Clinics (Antenatal care, safe delivery, and child clinics)
Immunization services
Mental health and pharmaceutical services
Referral services
Surgical services
Inpatient (IPD) and Outpatient (OPD) services
Laboratory services
Radiology services (X-ray, Ultrasound, ECHO)
Dental and oral health services
Non-Communicable Disease (NCD) services
Epidemic disease control
Health data collection and analysis
Control of communicable diseases (e.g., Malaria, Tuberculosis, HIV/AIDS)
Community health education for disease prevention and improved quality of life
B. Nutrition Unit
This unit is responsible for implementing national nutrition strategies and providing nutrition education at the community level. It focuses on improving the nutritional status of vulnerable groups and the general population to promote better health through proper nutrition.
Services provided include:
Nutrition screening for children under five years
Monitoring and evaluation of stunting, anemia, and malnutrition levels
Community nutrition education (through clinics, schools, and community groups)
Clinical nutrition counseling for admitted and outpatient patients
Collaboration with stakeholders in nutrition campaigns (such as World Nutrition Day)
Distribution and promotion of essential nutritional supplements for special groups (children, pregnant women, and breastfeeding mothers)
C. Social Welfare Unit
The Social Welfare Unit deals with social development and the welfare of families, children, the elderly, people with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups. The unit implements various social welfare policies aimed at ensuring an equitable, just, and socially secure community, especially for vulnerable populations.
Services provided include:
Counseling services for children, families, and individuals
Identification and management of vulnerable groups such as Orphans and Vulnerable Children (OVC) , the elderly, and people with disabilities
Coordination of childcare services through Daycare Centers
Handling cases of gender-based violence and violence against children through social welfare desks
Providing social assistance to needy individuals (food, shelter, and transport for referral services)
Awareness campaigns on human rights, gender equality, and family development
Collaboration with stakeholders (NGOs and international organizations) in social programs
5. Department Strategies for the Financial Year 2025/2026
For the 2025/2026 financial year , the Department of Health, Nutrition and Social Welfare has established the following strategies to improve services and strengthen community welfare.
A. Health Sector
Improve infrastructure of health service facilities, including completion of new dispensaries and health centers in high-need areas.
Increase availability of medicines and medical equipment by ensuring timely distribution of essential medicines to all health facilities.
Strengthen primary and preventive health services through vaccination campaigns and regular health screenings.
Encourage community participation in health services through community meetings and public health education.
Conduct monitoring and evaluation of health facility performance using DHIS2 and health statistics.
B. Nutrition Sector
Implement the National Multisectoral Nutrition Action Plan (NMNAP II) at the community level in collaboration with development partners.
Strengthen monitoring of children's nutritional status through regular weight, height, and hemoglobin assessments.
Conduct nutrition campaigns in schools and health facilities by providing nutrition education and supplements.
Support pregnant and breastfeeding women with proper nutrition education and supplements.
Build capacity of health workers on clinical nutrition services .
C. Social Welfare Sector
Establish and strengthen social welfare desks at ward level to address gender-based violence and child protection issues.
Coordinate services for the elderly, people with disabilities, and vulnerable children in collaboration with stakeholders.
Support care centers and safe houses to comply with national guidelines for quality care.
Provide community education on human rights, gender equality, and family welfare through meetings and community forums.
Strengthen collaboration with NGOs and faith-based organizations in delivering social services.

Divisheni ya Afya, Lishe na Ustawi wa Jamii
﻿ DIVISHENI YA AFYA, LISHE NA USTAWI WA JAMII
UTANGULIZI
Divisheni ya Afya, Lishe na Ustawi wa Jamii ni moja ya divisheni muhimu katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido. Divisheni hii ina jukumu la kuratibu, kusimamia na kutekeleza huduma za afya, lishe bora, na ustawi wa kijamii kwa wananchi wa Wilaya ya Longido.
DIRA NA DHIMA
Dira (Vision):
Kuwa na jamii yenye afya bora, lishe sahihi, na ustawi wa kijamii kwa maendeleo endelevu ya Wilaya ya Longido.
Dhima (Mission):
Kutoa huduma bora, jumuishi na endelevu za afya, lishe na ustawi wa jamii kwa wananchi wa Longido kwa kuzingatia usawa, ubora, haki za binadamu, na ushirikishwaji wa jamii.
VITENGO VILIVYO CHINI YA DIVISHENI
1. Kitengo cha Afya
Kitengo hiki kinasimamia utoaji wa huduma za afya ya msingi, kinga, tiba, na elimu ya afya katika ngazi ya jamii, kwa lengo la kuboresha huduma za afya kwa jamii ya Longido kwa kuzingatia ubora, usawa, na upatikanaji kwa wote.
Huduma zinazotolewa ni pamoja na:
Kliniki za mama na mtoto (Antenatal, uzazi salama, na kliniki za watoto)
Chanjo na huduma za kinga
Huduma za afya ya akili na tiba ya dawa
Huduma za rufaa na upasuaji
Huduma za wagonjwa wa ndani (IPD) na wa nje (OPD)
Huduma za maabara na mionzi (X-ray, Ultrasound, ECHO)
Huduma za kinywa na meno
Udhibiti wa magonjwa yasiyoambukiza (NCDs)
Udhibiti wa magonjwa ya mlipuko na kuambukiza (mfano Malaria, Kifua Kikuu, VVU/UKIMWI)
Ukusanyaji na uchambuzi wa takwimu za afya
Elimu ya afya kwa jamii ili kuzuia magonjwa na kuboresha maisha
2. Kitengo cha Lishe
Kitengo hiki kinahusika na utekelezaji wa mikakati ya kitaifa ya lishe na kutoa elimu ya lishe katika ngazi ya jamii, kwa lengo la kukuza afya bora kupitia lishe sahihi, hasa kwa makundi maalum.
Huduma zinazotolewa ni pamoja na:
Uchunguzi wa hali ya lishe kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano
Ufuatiliaji na tathmini ya udumavu, upungufu wa damu na utapiamlo
Elimu ya lishe bora kwa jamii (kupitia kliniki, shule, na vikundi vya kijamii)
Ushauri wa lishe kwa wagonjwa waliolazwa na wa kliniki (Clinical Nutrition)
Ushirikiano na wadau katika kampeni za lishe (kama Siku ya Lishe Duniani)
Usambazaji na matumizi ya virutubisho muhimu kwa makundi maalum (watoto, wajawazito, na wanaonyonyesha)
3. Kitengo cha Ustawi wa Jamii
Kitengo hiki kinashughulikia maendeleo ya kijamii na ustawi wa familia, watoto, wazee, watu wenye ulemavu, na makundi mengine maalum. Kinatekeleza sera mbalimbali za ustawi wa jamii kwa lengo la kuhakikisha jamii yenye usawa, haki na ustawi kwa wote, hasa walioko katika mazingira magumu.
Huduma zinazotolewa ni pamoja na:
Ushauri nasaha kwa watoto, familia na watu binafsi
Utambuzi na usimamizi wa makundi maalum kama watoto wanaoishi katika mazingira hatarishi (OVC), wazee, na watu wenye ulemavu
Kuratibu huduma za malezi ya watoto kupitia vituo vya kulelea watoto wadogo (Daycare centers)
Kushughulikia masuala ya ukatili wa kijinsia na dhidi ya watoto kupitia madawati ya ustawi wa jamii
Kutoa msaada wa kijamii kwa wahitaji (chakula, malazi, usafiri kwa ajili ya rufaa)
Uhamasishaji kuhusu haki za binadamu, usawa wa kijinsia na maendeleo ya familia
Ushirikiano na wadau (NGOs na mashirika ya kimataifa) katika shughuli za kijamii
MIKAKATI YA MWAKA 2025/2026
Sekta ya Afya
Kuboresha miundombinu ya vituo vya huduma za afya, ikijumuisha ukamilishaji wa ujenzi wa zahanati na vituo vya afya vinavyohitajika.
Kuongeza upatikanaji wa dawa na vifaa tiba kwa kuhakikisha usambazaji wa dawa muhimu kwa wakati.
Kuimarisha huduma za afya ya msingi na kinga, ikiwemo kampeni za chanjo na uchunguzi wa afya.
Kuhamasisha jamii kushiriki katika huduma za afya kupitia mikutano na elimu ya afya kwa umma.
Kufanya ufuatiliaji na tathmini ya utendaji kazi wa vituo vya afya kwa kutumia mfumo wa DHIS2 na takwimu za afya.
Sekta ya Lishe
Kutekeleza Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Lishe (NMNAP II) katika ngazi ya jamii kwa kushirikiana na wadau wa maendeleo.
Kuimarisha ufuatiliaji wa hali ya lishe ya watoto, kupima uzito, urefu na hali ya damu mara kwa mara.
Kuendesha kampeni za lishe shuleni na kwenye vituo vya afya, kwa kutoa elimu na virutubisho.
Kuwezesha wanawake wajawazito na wanaonyonyesha kupata lishe bora kwa kutoa ushauri na virutubisho stahiki.
Kujenga uwezo wa watumishi wa afya kuhusu huduma za lishe kliniki (Clinical Nutrition).
Sekta ya Ustawi wa Jamii
Kuanzisha na kuimarisha madawati ya ustawi wa jamii katika ngazi ya kata, kushughulikia masuala ya ukatili wa kijinsia na watoto.
Kuratibu utoaji wa huduma kwa wazee, watu wenye ulemavu na watoto wanaoishi katika mazingira magumu kwa kushirikiana na wadau mbalimbali.
Kuwezesha vituo vya kulelea watu wenye changamoto (Nyumba Salama) kuzingatia miongozo ya kitaifa ya malezi bora.
Kutoa elimu kuhusu haki za binadamu, usawa wa kijinsia na ustawi wa familia kwa jamii kupitia mikutano na makongamano ya kijamii.
Kuimarisha ushirikiano na mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali (NGOs) na taasisi za dini katika kutoa huduma za kijamii.

Health, Nutrition and Social Welfare Services
Longido District Council carries out its core responsibility of providing quality health services to its residents through various health service centers located across the district. These services aim to ensure that citizens receive preventive, curative, and health promotion services in a timely and high-quality manner.
Health Facilities Available
As of 2025, health services are provided through:
Longido District Hospital – Offers primary and referral services to patients from various wards within Longido District.
6 Health Centers – Located in Kimokouwa, Engarenaibor, Ketumbeine, Olmology, Gelailumbwa, and Namanga , providing medical services.
33 Dispensaries – Spread across different wards in the district, offering basic health care and treatment.
1 Special Home (Safe House) – For children with special needs in Longido District.
Types of Services Provided
Maternal and Child Health Services (vaccinations, antenatal and postnatal care for mothers and infants)
Emergency and Referral Services
Outpatient and General Medical Services
HIV Testing and Treatment, and Management of Chronic Diseases (e.g., diabetes, hypertension)
Mental Health Services and Counseling
Maternal Delivery Services
Community Health Education
Control of Epidemic and Communicable Diseases
Laboratory and Diagnostic Services
Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Services
Eye Care Services
Surgical Services
Mortuary Services
Radiology Services
Nutrition Services and Dietary Counseling
Dental Services
Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) Clinics
Community Welfare Services
Strategies to Improve Health Services for the 2025/2026 Financial Year
Complete the construction of the District Hospital , health centers, and new dispensaries in villages and wards without health facilities.
Increase the availability of essential medicines and medical equipment across all health facilities.
Build the capacity of health professionals through regular training.
Promote primary health care services through awareness campaigns.
Improve maternal and child health services to reduce maternal and infant mortality.
Establish and strengthen health information management systems using ICT.
Expand screening services for non-communicable diseases and provide counseling.
Ensure delivery of youth-friendly and specialized health services .
Strengthen community health services through Community Health Workers (CHWs).
Collaborate with development partners to mobilize resources for health projects.

Huduma za Afya,Lishe na Ustawi wa Jamii
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Longido inatekeleza majukumu ya msingi ya kutoa huduma bora za afya kwa wakazi wake kupitia vituo mbalimbali vya kutolea huduma za afya vilivyopo wilayani. Huduma hizi zinalenga kuhakikisha kuwa wananchi wanapata huduma za kinga, tiba, na uhamasishaji wa afya kwa wakati na kwa ubora unaostahili.
Vituo vya Afya Vilivyopo:
Hadi kufikia mwaka 2025, huduma za afya zinapatikana kupitia:
Hospitali ya Wilaya ya Longido – inatoa huduma za msingi na za rufaa kwa wagonjwa kutoka kata mbalimbali za Wilaya ya Longido.
Vituo vya Afya viko 6 – vilivyopo katika maeneo ya Kimokouwa, Engarenaibor, Ketumbeine, Olmology, Gelailumbwa na Namanga, na vinatoa huduma za matibabu.
Zahanati ziko 33 – zilizosambaa katika kata mbalimbali za Wilaya, zikitoa huduma za msingi za afya na matibabu.
Makao maalumu (nyumba salama) iko 1- nyumba ya watoto wenye uhitaji maalumu katika Wilaya ya Longido.

Mikakati ya Kuboresha Huduma za Afya kwa Mwaka wa Fedha 2025/2026:
